entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac, agent ID 301. How can I help you today?
Hi Isaac, I'm calling about an order I placed a little while ago. I need to make a return.
I can certainly help you with that. Can I get your name and order number, please?
Sure, the name is Alex Chen, and the order number is VF-8675309.
Thank you, Alex. Pulling that up now... I see the order for the Pro-Series jersey. What specifically seems to be the issue with the item?
The issue is that I ordered the wrong size. I finally tried it on for a longer ride and it's just too tight across the chest. It's not a defect, just a fit preference.

I understand. Sizing can be tricky. Let me check the purchase date... I see this was delivered 68 days ago. According to our policy, you are well within the 90-day return window for this jersey. I can process that for you right now.

Oh, that's great news. I appreciate that. I'm planning to order the next size up. Since I'm doing an exchange of sorts, is there any possibility of a small discount code for the new purchase? It would help offset the return shipping.

That's a reasonable question, Alex. Let me see... I do see here that you're a VIP member with us. Thank you for being such a loyal customer. For you, I can absolutely issue a 20% discount code for your next order. I'll have that sent to your email along with the return label.
A 20% discount is fantastic, thank you! That's more than I expected. I'll definitely place the order for the larger jersey today then. You've made this exchange process very simple.
You're very welcome. I've just initiated the return and sent that email with the prepaid label and your discount code. Is there anything else I can assist you with?
No, that's everything. Thank you for your help, Isaac.
It was my pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
